description: RuboCop::Cop::Style::RedundantSelf with ruby >= 2.7 with pattern matching registers an offense when using a self receiver with a pin
source:
foo = 17
case pattern
  in ^foo, *bar
    self.foo + self.bar + foo + bar
end
correction:
foo = 17
case pattern
  in ^foo, *bar
    foo + self.bar + foo + bar
end

description: RuboCop::Cop::Style::RedundantSelf with ruby >= 2.7 with pattern matching registers an offense when using self with a different match var
source:
case foo
  in Integer => bar
    self.bar + bar
  in Float => baz
    self.bar + baz
end
correction:
case foo
  in Integer => bar
    self.bar + bar
  in Float => baz
    bar + baz
end
